galleryIntro: Choose the closer recreation; immediately say how close it is while the sound is still on screen.
None are close and Skip advance immediately. Replay always starts at the beginning; feedback is saved locally.
This is a deliberately selected diagnostic, including strengths and weaknesses. Some references are familiar, but every pair includes a new recreation.
provenance.selectionPolicy: Outcome-selected six-case diagnostic: two additional native controls (one consensus improvement, one contour/overall-distance disagreement), two external sources, one altered input, and one regression on a previously very-close gesture. Not a representative quality estimate. New candidates are raw predictions, without local search.

provenance.proposalPolicy: distinct mode primaries ranked by mode probability; fill with joint categorical beam; deduplicate canonical controls

pitch.directionMeaning: direction and startToEndSemitones describe voiced-span motion between the median log pitches of the first and last three voiced frames; they do not establish motion at whole-sound endpoints.
pitch.meaning: V5 descriptor diagnostic on 48 active-sound relative-time positions; nulls are inactive or unvoiced. Not independent ground truth, likeness certification, or a selection criterion.

pitchComparison.directionMeaning: Matches voiced-span direction on the reported support frames of each sound; not whole-sound endpoint evidence.
